research_basis.authoring_method: Original synthesis using the user brief and the THE DMI implementation reference as the structural benchmark.
research_basis.licence_handling: Original implementation content informed by Jisc structure. Jisc digital maturity materials are published under terms including CC BY-NC-SA on the main toolkit page; scenarios and practitioner language here are independently written.
notes: The source brief describes a 3-level model and requests 10 boundaries. This implementation therefore operationalises the two assessable adjacent boundaries in a 3-level model: Established to Enhanced (EM) and Enhanced to Mature (MM).
The brief also mentioned EE as a target-level code; that label is retained in metadata as an entry-threshold alias rather than a scored boundary.

objects.plain_language_rewrite: Established means has moved beyond scattered activity but remains uneven or reactive.
what_good_looks_like: People can point to concrete evidence of organisational digital culture, not just aspirations.
The approach is understandable to others and not reliant on one exceptional case.
Decisions and behaviours are reasonably consistent with the stated level.
objects.accurate_self_assessment_prompt: What evidence would a sceptical colleague ask to see before agreeing that organisational digital culture is genuinely established?
objects.common_overclaim: Pointing to a few good examples and describing them as if they represent the whole picture.
objects.common_underclaim: Ignoring steady progress because the institution has not yet reached a fully exemplary state.
